policy.singleImages: recover the dominant object and nearby legitimate components from each full canonical sheet; discard disconnected edge fragments found in the old slices
policy.destructibles: recover each object from the full canonical sheet; preserve nearby detached parts; repack to four 362x181 frames
policy.scaling: uniform downscale only when selected content does not fit the original canvas with required padding

exceptions: Destructibles are rebuilt from sheets_alpha/destruibles.png because the previous fixed-row slices had already discarded overflowing pixels.
Single-image objects are rebuilt from their complete sheets_alpha sources for the same reason; the old slices remain in the recoverable backup.
Canvas dimensions remain unchanged for every single image and every destructible strip.
